_provenance.determinism_note: Hard rule 5. Every STATISTIC in this file is a deterministic function of the analysed artifacts: no wall-clock reading and no RNG enters any figure, and no generation timestamp is recorded. Re-running on an unchanged tree reproduces every number byte-for-byte. The single field that varies between runs is 'git_head' above, which records WHICH repository state was analysed and must change when the commit does. To diff two runs, ignore that field.

SCOPE_B_MINIMAL_L1_and_L3.note: C10000 isolates L1 and C00100 isolates L3, each against the already-3-run C00000 baseline.

WHAT_IT_BUYS: Each defended cell currently has run_index 0 only. Two additional runs per cell gives 3 runs, matching the baseline, so every per-layer delta becomes a 3-run-mean vs 3-run-mean comparison with its own measured standard error, instead of a single draw against a single draw. That converts the D12 verdict from UNRESOLVABLE to a measured result and settles L1 (+0.077) and L3 (+0.058) outright rather than by inference.
WHAT_IT_DOES_NOT_BUY: It does not reproduce the ORIGINAL responses. Condition drift is already demonstrated: baseline_regen re-ran the same baseline 3 weeks later and only 19 of 267 responses were byte-identical. New runs measure variance under CURRENT conditions, so they must be reported as a fresh 3-run block, not pooled with the original run 0.
